<script lang="ts">
  import Child from '$lib/Child.svelte';
  import { fmt } from '$lib/utils';
  export let name: string;
  let count = 0;
  function inc() { count += 1; }
  function tip(node: HTMLElement) { return {}; }
  function fly(node: HTMLElement) { return {}; }
  function slideIn(node: HTMLElement) { return {}; }
  function flip(node: HTMLElement) { return {}; }
  let active = false;
  function neverUsedAction(node: HTMLElement) { return {}; }
  function unusedHandler() { count = 0; }
</script>

<h1>Hello {name}! {fmt(count)}</h1>
<button on:click={inc} use:tip transition:fly|local in:slideIn animate:flip class:active>+</button>
<Child value={count} />
<img src=logo.png alt="logo">
{#if count > 1}<p>many</p>{/if}

<style>
  h1 { color: red }
</style>
